data.description:
## Problem
The scheduled main test.yml `sweep (windows)` job has failed on the last 3 consecutive scheduled runs (34321330218, 34353500045, 34391071987; 2026-09-08..09). Signature: collection ERROR in tests/interfaces/store/test_mcp_write_lock_dead_stamp.py plus a cascade of setup ERRORs in store/MCP round-trip tests (test_rebuild_refuses_when_snapshot_cites_missing_sources, test_repair_snapshots_dry_run_writes_nothing, test_fsck_surfaces_missing_sources, test_round_trip_ack_202_then_terminal, guard tests, ...). Windows-only: the gating ubuntu cell and macos sweep pass on the same SHAs.

## Suspected shape
A recently-landed store/MCP test module or fixture uses a POSIX-only primitive at import/setup time (e.g. fcntl/flock, signal, or unix-path assumption) without a windows skip/guard. test_mcp_write_lock_dead_stamp suggests the write-lock dead-stamp work.

## AC
- Root cause identified per debugging protocol (read the full windows log; reproduce or prove statically which import/fixture fails on win32).
- Fix the class: guard or portability-fix the offending module/fixture so the windows sweep collects and passes; add the appropriate skip marker only if the tested mechanism is genuinely POSIX-only.
- Next scheduled (or manually dispatched) windows sweep green.
data.title: sweep (windows) red 3 consecutive scheduled runs: POSIX-only import/setup in store/MCP write-lock tests
